tests.name: Generating again is deterministic and preserves real cuts
Setting five panels does not change the existing snapshot until regeneration
Explicit five transverse sections generate five complete metric rectangles
Repack/stitch do not erase transverse/longitudinal cuts
Filling retains rectangular shape, length ratio and geometry identity
All geometry UV targets are the same submitted face-corner UV data
Playback rate and pause do not move the free camera
